encoding.tree: binary, odd tail pairs with itself at the last node of an odd level

negative.name: forged_fourth_leaf_on_three_row_bucket
negative.why_rejected: leaf_count is claimed as 4 while the bucket has 3 rows; the duplicated odd tail must not read as a distinct position

negative.name: pending_row_presented_as_established
negative.why_rejected: the bucket field must match the row's verdict

negative.name: leaf_index_out_of_range
negative.why_rejected: leaf_index >= leaf_count is a fabricated position

negative.name: truncated_sibling_path
negative.why_rejected: the sibling count must equal depth(leaf_count); a short path would otherwise be reinterpreted as a shallower tree

negative.name: siblings_reused_across_levels
negative.why_rejected: a path where the same digest is repeated off the odd tail is the self-pairing smuggled into a full level

negative.name: wrong_bucket_root_target
negative.why_rejected: opening against the Pending root must not establish a row from the Established bucket

negative.name: established_row_without_event_attestation
negative.why_rejected: an Established row must bind all four commitments

negative.name: established_row_with_zero_fault_tolerance
negative.why_rejected: 0 bps means the domain grants no safety; it may not be certified

negative.name: conflicting_checkpoint_heights
negative.why_rejected: one certificate cannot seal two checkpoints

negative.name: duplicate_domain_id
negative.why_rejected: two rows for one domain means two final heights
